description.en: Lets the remote control itself: button backlight level and color, display brightness and timeout, sleep, wake, sound and haptics, plus Smart Controls: conditional buttons you build in a browser.

value.en: This integration changes the remote's own settings and adds Smart Controls (conditional buttons). On the next screen it asks for the web-configurator PIN once, to create an API key it keeps on the remote. The PIN itself is not stored.
